name: Spicy Indian Chickpea Stew (Chana Masala) with Spinach & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses 4 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 jalapeño pepper
1 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl with the garlic and ginger, then set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Set aside to drain further.
When the onion is softened, add ginger, garlic, jalapeño, and spices to the pot with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp garam masala
2 tsp curry powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chickpeas, tomatoes, and broth to the pot; stir to combine the chana masala and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chickpeas are tender and sauce has thickened, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: When the chana masala is done, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.

Divide rice and chana masala between containers and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat chana masala and rice in a saucepan or microwave and enjoy!
